title: Survive a context compaction by re-reading the pattern
description: After a long session is summarised or cut, the details are gone. Re-read the pattern instead of guessing.
root_cause: A summary keeps the gist and loses the exact commands and constraints.
diagnosis_steps:
1. Note the pattern numbers you rely on.
2. After a compaction, fetch them again (GET /<id>) and the rules (GET /boot).
quick_fix: Never continue from the summary alone when a pattern covers the task.
root_fix: Write progress into a pattern during long tasks so it survives.
